statement: The Popol Vuh creation cycle includes unsuccessful attempts to make satisfactory humans before a successful creation of people from yellow and white maize; the surviving Ximénez manuscript is an early-18th-century transcription of an earlier K’iche’ text and tradition.

sources.citation: Library of Congress, “Popol Vuh: Transcription in Quiché Mayan and Translation into Spanish,” World Digital Library/Newberry manuscript description.
Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian, “Creation Story of the Maya,” Living Maya Time.

does_not_demonstrate: Motif similarity with another tradition does not by itself demonstrate borrowing, common ancestry, or direct transmission.
